a.text: Among the debris and crumbled walls, the monster's bloated corpse fills much of the karst cave. Its bizarre body, which had until now emanated a strange sense of beauty, begins to stiffen as it dreads its impending doom.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It is leaking water everywhere. Let's finish it off. We need to go.

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: Why do you blind philistines get to live, while I must fail when I have dedicated my entire life to this noble goal...?

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: You are mere pets of Ægir! Blind and stagnant... You are nothing but a nuisance to science and to the future!

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: I am... so close to the truth! Why must I die here while you... you get to escape the punishment you deserve?!

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: I've come so far! My will and my flesh were on the verge of exceeding the limitations of man! Why?!

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: Why? Why?! Why!!

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: Ægir... will fall. Nothing will be left of you... Nothing...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You fool. I'm Ægir. As long as I'm alive, Ægir is alive.

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: You... But...

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: Ironic... How ironic.

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: You are different. Huff... You are destined to be different...

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: You know it. Your destiny is all but set in stone.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Enough of your nonsense. Just die already. That's the only thing I ask of you, and I'm being plenty sincere about this.

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: Curse you... Curse you all... until the lands fall... You will flee the sea... only to find yourself dissolved in its waters like salt.

steps.name: Bishop?
steps.text: On the barren wastelands lined with your corpses, our ceaseless waves will engulf all of the world's land!

a.text: Gladiia seems to be trying to control herself. The last bit of her courtesy is merely a byproduct of the contempt she cannot contain.
The bishop whimpers as he reaches his limb out to Gladiia.
But before it could reach the hunter, the limb has stiffened, twitched, and curled into a ball.
The bishop is dead, and he will be forgotten completely.
Gladiia looks at Specter and Skadi.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: He is gone, at long last. This has finally come to an end... I ended it by my own hands... yet this is nowhere nearly as satisfying as I imagined.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Compared to all they have done to me, this is far from enough, but that's one down, two to go for us.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Ugh, I'm getting a little dizzy. How did I come to this place? It feels almost like a dream.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Shark?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I can't... stay awake for long after all...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: We finally have their tentacles caught. If we grab it now and pluck its roots out there, we will definitely find a way to heal you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: That isn't a big problem. As it stands, they cannot control me, and I feel exceptionally well. The feeling of freedom... Who could have known I would get to experience it now? This has me so elated, it feels as though I'm flying high with excitement.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Though, Captain, I am afraid I heard everything you said.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Was the bishop saying we will become Seaborns too? Captain, will you become one of those more formidable kinds? They are quite strong.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: That won't happen.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You are way too different from them.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I hope my actions didn't put you two in harm's way.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Answer a few questions for me.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Ask away.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Is there Seaborn blood flowing in our veins?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You are here to figure out the cause of the problems in Specter's body, and you took that blow to figure out why the Seaborn was looking for me.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Yes, that's right.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: And you knew from the start the bishop wasn't the only Seaborn here?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Do you know what I did after that final battle that was borderline suicide?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I don't.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Did we win?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I don't know. I lost contact with Ægir.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Are we abandoned by Ægir...?

a.text: Yes? The Abyssal Hunters are like bait.
Yes? The Abyssal Hunters are like a glow at the bottom of the sea.
Yes? The Abyssal Hunters are strong, yet their strength is but a tiny fraction of Ægir's power.
Yes? The only thing special about the Abyssal Hunters is that they are indeed related to the sea monsters somehow.
Anger rages in Skadi's crimson pupils, but there is that tiny bit of hope...
How much of it is real, and how much of it is fake...?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: We're not.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Okay, let's go.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: How snappy.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: No reason to dawdle around. I'm an Abyssal Hunter.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Is it somehow different for you girls in your squad?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: All Abyssal Hunters are like that.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: This place is about to collapse. Besides...

a.text: As though lured here by the bishop's lifeless body, the Sea Terrors are boring into the cave through the fissures.
In huge numbers, no less.
Three hunters are walking on seacoast way♪

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: There's too many of them.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Skadi, I need you to apply yourself here! You are the only one whose arms and legs aren't all scrapped up!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: What do you want me to do...? My hands are numb already. When was the last time you had to stick your hands into their mouths to tear them into two?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: About three seconds ago.

a.text: Gladiia turns around and sticks her hand into the mouth of one of the monsters, piercing its entire body through its head. She quickly swings her arm, and, unable to withstand the force the hunter is exerting on its body, the monster is torn into two from the inside before being flung away.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Just now.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: No, as long as its body is still there... there will be no end to the Sea Terrors. It's summoning them. It's an anchor!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: We'll need to destroy the body, then... Burying it won't quite be enough...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I'll do it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: When you have a huge hole in you?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You two—

a.text: A figure appears before the Hunters, surprising Skadi when she sees her face.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Get moving, Hunters!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: What are you doing there?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We'll talk later! Mon3tr, do it!

a.text: Mon3tr crashes into the ceiling of the chapel. It tears the Sea Terrors apart with its sharp blades. A black sphere forms in its mouth before blasting away downwards.
It shakes the entire city and hill, sending what is left of the chapel crumbling down.
The bishop and its secrets have been destroyed forever, and no one will know any of it.
